content.text: Verifying the final CLI-produced files are the corrected layouts:

All three sizes are rendered, verified and defect‑free. **Files in the working folder** - `square.png` — 1080×1080 (master) - `landscape.png` — 1920×1080 - `story.png` — 1080×1920 - `card.html` — single responsive source (picks a layout variant from the viewport), `check.js` — layout verifier **Design** - `#0F1226` base with a violet ambient glow and faint masked grid; white text, `#7C5CFF` accent. - Inter loaded via `@font-face` from the local `Inter.ttf` (variable, weights 100–900). - Logo + a hairline divider + `FIELDNOTES CONF 2026` as the lockup; "KEYNOTE" eyebrow above the talk title; date/venue on an accent dot row above a hairline; pill CTA. **Per-size composition** - **Square:** brand top, title centred in the open middle, footer row with the circular portrait + name/role on the left and the pill on the right. - **Landscape:** two columns — text block left, 460px hero circle right; the footer spans the full width so the CTA lands on the right edge instead of floating mid-canvas. - **Story:** fully centred poster — 384px portrait, name/role, title, then meta + CTA pinned to the bottom; the speaker/title group is optically centred with paired auto margins. **Verification** (`node check.js` measures real geometry in Chromium at each viewport): no element overflows the canvas, no clipped scroll overflow, no overlapping boxes, and every `.avatar` plus its `` measures exactly square (132², 460², 384²) with `border-radius:50%`, so the crop stays a true circle. The title wraps to 3/3/4 balanced lines respectively with nothing cut off.
